the private spin_fast_coefficient_count to zero, matching the existing regression-test
forcing control. Seven interleaved warm samples are recorded for both synthesis and analysis
at q=1 and q=8; outputs are compared before timing. Command: taskset -c "${RUSTSHT_CPUSET:?set RUSTSHT_CPUSET}" cargo test --release -p rustsht --lib
